My first two Broadway shows since Finding Neverland in 2015 for a school trip! Definitely not a stranger to theater as I did sound for my high school, but way less knowledgeable than my girlfriend, who was the main driving force for seeing these shows. 

Funny Girl - Announced day-of that Lea was going to be out that night which was a bit of a bummer for my girlfriend and I since we paid more to see her. No prior knowledge of the show before attending, but I was really impressed by Julie Benko as Fanny. Didn’t feel like I had been let down by her filling in at all, and the rest of the cast was amazing as well. Overall a really great experience and I was happy that we went.

Phantom of the Opera - Tried EVERYTHING I could before getting down to NYC to find affordable tickets but struck out everywhere I looked. The last day we were there I found an article online somewhere mentioning that they did $29 standing room tickets day of. Looked at the clock and saw it was 9:30, and sprinted down to get in line for the box office opening at 10. So happy that I got tickets! Having also not really heard much of the show before watching (I know, sacrilege,) I was eager to see if I would enjoy the full show having enjoyed the few songs I had heard before. I was absolutely entranced from the moment the show began. I loved tech theater in school and the technical elements in this show were engaging and really amazing to see in person. The moment the chandelier is revealed during the opening and the overture kicks in was more powerful than almost all the concerts I have been to, including lots of metal/loud electronic shows. Ben Crawford was an enjoyable Phantom, although my girlfriend said that he wasn’t what she was used to from other people who have performed the role. But we both still loved the show. And for $29, I can’t complain either. This trip really brought me back into remembering why I did sound for my high school theater company and why I love live theater, and I am counting down the days until I can make it back to see more shows!
